description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kavisigamuwa, Rideegama, D/S/Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.420066 (24/504)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (No. 13.1 and 13:2) in Kurunegala District, including detailed particulars of ownership, extent, class of title, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land registration, property ownership determinations, and title settlement matters.
